definitions: A chemoreceptor that is located on the tongue and adjacent tissues and that is responsible for the sense of taste.
Any of the clusters of cells found on the tongue, soft palate, epiglottis, and upper esophagus, which are responsible for the sense of taste.
examples: Sweetness is detected by taste buds.
Each taste bud has 50 to 100 receptor cells.
The taste buds on the tip of the tongue are more sensitive to sweet and salty tastes.
